# 🧮 Reconstruction Ceiling
**theorem** · swordsman · knowledge

R_max = (C_S + C_M) / H(X). While the capacity-deficit condition C_S + C_M < H(X) holds against the stated adversary class, R_max < 1 and reconstruction in the stated sense is impossible. The deficit is declared, not derived (2026-10-07): conditional independence alone does not give it.
